operator.trait: Attacks deal Arts damage and heal the HP of an ally within Attack Range for 50% of the damage dealt

basicInfo.Infection Status: Showed physical signs of Originium , infection confirmed by medical report.

review.official:
The public face of
Rhodes Island
and its top executive. Although Amiya appears to be a young and inexperienced girl, she is universally trusted and highly qualified for her position.
Amiya now leads the island in fighting for the future of the
Infected
and striving to exorcise the dark shadow of
Originium
from the land.

files.description:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 20%

About Her Highness? You sure I'm the best person to answer that, Doctor? I'm just a simple boiler worker. What could I possibly know that the Doctor of Rhodes Island wouldn't? Oh, you wanna hear what an average Rhodes Island Sarkaz thinks of the former King?
We're standing pretty close to the boiler here, so you'd better sit by the fan while I have a think.
Before Her Highness's reign, the King who ruled over Kazdel was named Yliš. He wasn't a brutal tyrant or nothing, but he didn't do anything impressive either. None of the Royal Court were loyal to him, but nobody rose up against him. And later, as we all know, there were a pair of mixed-blood twins in his court: one an armed bodyguard for the King, and the other a royal tailor. That's right, the General and Her Highness, exactly as you knew them.
After Yliš's death in battle, they rose to the occasion and led the remaining Sarkaz in a counterattack. I still remember how the textbooks would describe it: 'Her Highness, not yet coronated, never laid down her needle and thread, weaving tactics and strategy with the other heroes. As the rapacious enemy surged into the Sarkaz capital, they fell into a deadly trap.' It wasn't easy, living through such a bloody battle.
There was this one Goliath warrior who found himself trapped under a pile of enemy corpses as he was dying. At least until Her Highness came to him. He saw her holding a faint ray of light, and she spun it on a colorless spindle to form a barely-visible staff in her hand. His wounds mended, and his shattered limbs returned to their original positions. He'd never seen Arts like that. Like a tailor darning life itself.
When Her Highness was formally coronated, many cheered with joy, but others weren't too happy about it. The General chopped off the latter's heads. And for the next two centuries or so, Her Highness tried to heal Kazdel.
Now, this is just a cliché, but the soil of Kazdel is always being watered by the blood of the Sarkaz. Her Highness wanted to change that. As the King, she could do a lot of things, but there were always more that required her attention. Damn near never-ending. With Dame Kal'tsit's at her side, she was able to personally save many lives. But Her Highness knew that in the time it took to save ten lives, a hundred would be lost. If she could save a hundred, there'd be a thousand more she couldn't. And even the King was helpless in the face of Oripathy.
For the first few years of the civil war, more than a few people mocked her for leaving Kazdel. I've heard it plenty myself, but was never sure what to say. Their mothers safely gave birth to them in hospitals built almost a hundred years ago, and they were taught in travelling schools established about fifty years back. That's the only reason they even know fancy phrases like 'blind charity,' 'lacking foresight' or 'falling to foreign influences'... Ah, sorry Doctor, caught me ranting a bit there.
I don't dare guess what Her Highness was thinking back then. And I believe you, Amiya, and Dame Kal'tsit will steer this ship towards a brighter future.
But sometimes I wonder if this ship can really achieve Her Highness's dream one day.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are you busy? Oh, it's fine if you don't have time to chat. I need to get some work done too, how about we eat together after we're done?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor...? All is well. I'm just reading this book. I suddenly realized that Theresa once read it to me, though even now I don't know how it ends. Tears...? Maybe it's because... it's such a heartwarming story.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yes, another ring of mine broke. Dr. Kal'tsit says no material could stand against such intense emotion. But even though this ring is broken, I still want to keep wearing it. It's both a restraint and a blessing. I'll make good use of it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, Blaze invited me to an event she's organizing. It's to celebrate our return to the landship, and a lot of elite operators will be there. Will I be joining them for drinks? No, of course I... Doctor, you and Dr. Kal'tsit are always looking after me, so you should know I've grown up a bit, but not that much.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've come to understand more and more how difficult it was for Theresa. What should I do? I think... I'll go and see Kazdel, as it is today. W will stand with me. And... there'll be more, others, in the future… Yes, I'm feeling more confident now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I touched and felt Theresa's every emotion. She was full of love and hope... for this great land, the Sarkaz, the people by her side, and herself. But all of it came to a sudden end, along with her life. She was holding onto so much sorrow... and so am I.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit has seen so much death. She was forced to watch many of her loved ones go, one by one. It's just... too painful. I've grown up now, so I can shoulder more responsibility for her. She doesn't have to walk alone anymore. Doctor, I want her to know that we're here for her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I expected as much... Thank you. Oh, Doctor? Do you want to talk with 'Civilight Eterna' too? Alright, come over here, don't be nervous... Just like this, feel the flowing energy. Feels like she's holding your hands, right? You'll get along well, I'm certain of it, and I always have been.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, I can feel your guilt, confusion... and sorrow. But you shouldn't be trapped by your past. This is what Theresa and I both wish for you. We still have lots of work to do. The one who ignited the flame of hope may no longer be with us, but the fire still burns. Babel never truly fell.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you well-rested? If you're still feeling tired, you don't have to force yourself to work. I'm here, after all.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor, this is another one of my powers. I still can't heal every injury I see.... but I'll keep you safe. I'll protect the ones I love.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Could I use all my different powers in the same fight? Oh, Doctor. I was just talking to myself.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can feel so much sorrow… so much sadness…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's keep moving forward.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Fighting... is the only option here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Amiya here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm here, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This staff is bound to my thoughts.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Mine and Theresa's emotions... I'll manifest them here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Love will heal our scars.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Tears will bathe new life.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Nostalgia... won't slow my steps.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Through the grim perils of the longest night, we shall breach into the promised dawn.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I don't want to lose anyone else. I'll carry on this fight, for every sacrifice, and all those still alive.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The flames of hatred still spread. I'll try to extinguish them, no matter... how many times it takes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I've made a few slips... No, it's not your fault, Doctor. I could have done better here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I won't let anyone hurt you, Doctor. Hold onto me, and don't let go, okay?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm so glad to be home.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yes, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you have something to say?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Where's that form...? Hmm... I'm looking for a financial statement from Closure. Where did I put it...? Right here! Oh, it's a summary report from HR... Which reminds me, I haven't checked the new purchase order yet either... Doctor, I won't make it to the party. So I'll wish you a happy new year right here. Ahem-hem: happy new year! Oh? You want to stay with me?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome home, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Do you want me to... play the violin like before? I didn't get to sneak in much practice... Oh, the time we have to ourselves just gets shorter and shorter these days... But luckily, I know your favorite tune by heart, and I'll never forget it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Another year has passed, and Rhodes Island is still sailing onwards. Doctor, tonight was just so wonderful I wish I could hide it away, deep in my mind. Thank you for staying by my side. We'll spend this very same day next year, together.
